newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat wins Malaysian tilting train contract.
newsitem.headline: Fiat wins Malaysian tilting train contract.

text.p: Fiat Ferroviaria, the railway engineering arm of the Fiat group, said on Wednesday it won a 180 billion lire contract to supply its Pendolino tilting trains to Malaysia.

The company said in a statement it would supply seven train sets, each comprising six coaches, with an option to sell a further 15 trains to the Malaysian Railways (KTMB). It was the first such contract for the Pendolino train in Asia.

Fiat Ferroviaria, which is in a consortium with other companies headed by Diversified Resources Berhad, one of Malaysia's biggest private industrial groups, won the contract in the face of competition from Japan, said the statement.
